Gmnotes: The breach forms along the ritual perimeter while PCs choose between holding enemies back and stabilizing ward flow. Threat emerges through the weakest perimeter point rather than a doorway. Environmental; pressure rises when the table ignores the breach or overloads the Custodian.
Gmscript: Say: "This board tracks wraith range, who is isolated, who can call them back, and when the countdown frees an Untethered soul."
Gmreadaloud: The wraiths hold the far edge. Memory-cold air splits the field. The center still needs protection while souls are pulled loose.

Gmchecklist: Use Memory Delve sparingly and per-PC. Use Pass-Through only to create rescue play. If whole party becomes Untethered, all mark 2 HP and return. At countdown zero, clear remaining threats and move to S05-06/S05-07.
Gmprivate: The audit meaning and soul-economy stay GM-only dread unless the denouement gate is earned.
Playertakeaway: The runes stutter. Somewhere under the soil, something old receives permission to continue.
Storytakeaway: The wraith map turns rescue and memory into the emotional heart of the finale.
Mechanictakeaway: Memory Delve, Pass-Through, Vulnerable, Untethered, resistance, Death Move, and countdown release resolve here.
